description: Create several short links in one call. Each item follows the same rules as shorten_url. Items that fail do not stop the others: the response lists the created links and the errors separately.

urls.description: Links to create, one object per link.

destination.description: Full http(s) URL to redirect to.

slug.description: Custom slug. A random one is used when omitted.

utm_campaign.description: UTM campaign name. Added to the destination URL.

utm_content.description: UTM content (ad or link variant). Added to the destination URL.

utm_medium.description: UTM medium, e.g. email. Added to the destination URL.

utm_source.description: UTM source, e.g. newsletter. Added to the destination URL.

utm_term.description: UTM term (paid keyword). Added to the destination URL.

name: shorten_urls
